result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with a functional layout. One minor styling inconsistency was found in the favorite (heart) button treatment between restaurant cards.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button styling is inconsistent between the 'Popular right now' cards. The Tokumaru Ramen card shows a heart icon inside a white circle, while the pizza card below shows a heart icon inside a dark/translucent circle.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the heart button background and icon color across all restaurant cards to maintain visual consistency.
